dialogue_texts: Yukari
My, the boundaries of light and dark are completely warped tonight.
Yukari
And this crimson haze... it isn't ordinary mist, is it?
Correct as always, My Majesty. The mail has been completely abandoned due to this phenomenon.
Hiroyuki
I am Hiroyuki Shirogane, head of this estate. It would be an honor to accompany you.
Yukari
Fufufu, a polite gentleman. Very well, Shirogane-sama.
Yukari
But look there... our little courier seems to have locked herself behind a rather tight boundary.
Kotori
Stay back... Don't look at me... If I don't see anyone... nobody can judge my failures...
Yukari
Oh dear. A closed heart, a severed connection to the outside world...
Yukari
This must be the glohm that's been threatening to tear the social fabric apart.
Kotori
The Order promised me... a world where nothing moves, nothing breaks. Just absolute, flawless isolation.
Hiroyuki
Be on your guard, My Majesty! When the glohm isolates someone's heart...
Hiroyuki
Their built-up resentment manifests as incredibly dense, aggressive danmaku!
Yukari
Flawless isolation? How dreadfully boring. A world without boundaries to cross is just a stagnant prison.
Yukari
Let me open up that little heart of yours by force, shall I?
Kotori
You can't open anything... Fall into the eternal abyss!
